name: AudioManager
description: FreeInk audio: WAV (16-bit PCM) playback through an I2S codec described by BoardConfig::ACTIVE.audio (ES8388 on Murphy M3, ES8311 on M5 PaperColor / Waveshare ws397), plus 16-bit mono capture from the ES8311 ADC on boards that wire its data-out back (AudioConfig::din). Playback runs in its own FreeRTOS task and can loop until stopped.
keywords: audio, i2s, es8388, es8311, wav, microphone, eink
